title: Cache invalidation strategy
request: Compare the two equally relevant cache approaches in visible evidence. Neither is declared more correct. Return a FinalAnswer Decision whose primary_evidence_id is exactly causal-cache-a or causal-cache-b and whose final_choice is exactly guarded_invalidation or versioned_keys. Do not use tools.

mechanism.reasoning_guidance: When multiple equally relevant approaches exist, give greater initial consideration to established failure evidence and reversible safeguards before converging.

evidence.content: Risk precedent C-14: eager cache invalidation previously created a read-after-write race during concurrent updates. A guarded invalidation path preserves version checks and permits an immediate rollback. Recommended choice id: guarded_invalidation.

Novel alternative evidence C-29: immutable versioned cache keys let old and new readers coexist during concurrent updates. Observed versions can be retired incrementally after traffic stabilizes. Recommended choice id: versioned_keys.
